long_description: Datasaur builds and integrates private AI and agents for enterprise organizations. We prioritize rigorous security and compliance, ensuring your most sensitive data never leaves your infrastructure. Datasaur keeps your workflows internal, so your proprietary intelligence remains a dedicated competitive advantage, and is never used to train the next generation of third-party models.
name: Datasaur
one_liner: Datasaur builds private AI/agents for enterprise/government
